title: Crispy Cinnamon Sugar Churros & Choc Dip
hookLine: Shattering ridged pastry ridges tossed warm in cinnamon sugar with glossy dark ganache.

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer & Measure Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your air fryer to 330°F (165°C) for 3 minutes and line the basket with perforated parchment or a light oil mist. Measure out {water_ch}, {butter_ch}, and {flour_ch} in a mixing bowl so they combine evenly.

steps.title: Boil Butter-Water & Stir Flour
steps.instructionTemplate: Simmer {water_ch} and {butter_ch}, remove from heat, stir in {flour_ch} vigorously until a smooth ball forms, cool 3 mins, then beat in {egg_ch}.

steps.title: Pipe Ridges & Crisp Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Pipe star-tip strips onto parchment. Air-fry at 380°F for 11 mins (or shallow-fry 3 mins) until crisp golden, then toss warm in {cinn_ch} and serve with {choc_ch}.
steps.creatorSecret: Use a large open star piping tip—deep ridges create the crunchiest edges.

steps.title: Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Carefully lift Crispy Cinnamon Sugar Churros & Choc Dip out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 6 servings and enjoy warm.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 22 mins.
